name: Node.js
description: Installs the Node.js runtime with npm and npx on a selectable channel or release line.

version.description: Channel (lts|latest), a major line (24 or 24.19), or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.

ignoreScripts.description: Set NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true to skip dependency install scripts; npm run still runs a script by name.

npmrc.description: npm config as INI with backslash-escaped line breaks, written to .npmrc.
